_comment: FICTIONAL sample data. Shaped to match what etzm/open-twin can actually produce - see docs/SCHEMA_VERIFICATION.md. Systems with no connector are hasData:false with score:null and MUST render as 'no data', never as a number. UBERON ids are standard terms; confirm each against the HRA release before relying on them.

biologicalAge.caveat: No connector produces biological age. It would be a metric this project invents.

cardiovascularAge.caveat: From Oura 'vascular age'. No standard LOINC or SNOMED concept exists; vendor-local code pending clinical sign-off.

systems.name: Cardiovascular
systems.summary: Resting heart rate and HRV within a healthy band; blood pressure trending slightly high.

systems.name: Musculoskeletal
systems.summary: Posture and joint angles from BodyLoop within reference; strong activity and mobility markers.

systems.name: Respiratory
systems.summary: SpO2 stable and respiratory rate within range. Limited signal: no spirometry connected.

systems.name: Metabolic
systems.summary: VO2max and activity acceptable. Glucose coding unresolved upstream, so lab-derived markers are excluded.

systems.name: Nervous System
systems.summary: Derived from sleep, stress and resilience proxies. These are not nervous-system measurements. Relabelling this system to 'Sleep & Recovery' is an open decision.

systems.name: Digestive
systems.summary: No connected data source produces digestive measurements.

systems.name: Endocrine
systems.summary: No connected data source produces endocrine measurements.

systems.name: Reproductive
systems.summary: No connected data source produces reproductive measurements.

systems.name: Integumentary
systems.summary: No connected data source. Oura skin temperature deviation exists but has no standard concept and is not a system score.
